descriptor.label: MCP Tool Definitions
descriptor.description: Export as an MCP server descriptor: one tool per operation, with a unique name, a description, an inputSchema from the parameters and body, and an outputSchema where the protocol revision supports it.
descriptor.unavailable_reason: MCP Tool Definitions export needs at least one operation an agent can call (not an event, a stream, an MCP resource or a prompt); this source has none.

protocol_version.description: MCP protocol revision the descriptor targets. `2025-06-18` (default) adds `outputSchema`; `2025-03-26` has none, so what a tool returns stays in its description.
protocol_version.title: Protocol Version

grouping.description: `single` writes one server descriptor; `per-service` writes one descriptor per service (`<server>-<service>.mcp.json`), for large APIs.
grouping.title: Grouping

output_schema.description: Write a tool's `outputSchema` from its success response when the response is an object (2025-06-18). A server built from the descriptor must then return matching `structuredContent`; turn it off to describe the result in the description only.
output_schema.title: Output Schema

include_deprecated.description: Also write a tool for each deprecated operation (its description says so).
include_deprecated.title: Include Deprecated
